description: This file defines a class `Image_Graph_Plot_Dot` for rendering a dot/scatter plot marker in a graphing library. It extends a base plot class and includes methods for drawing legend samples and rendering the plot.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot_Dot
classes.description: A class that renders a simple dot or scatter plot, showing only markers for data points.

methods.name: _drawLegendSample
methods.description: Draws a sample marker in the legend area, using the plot's marker for visualization.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Finalizes the plot rendering, including grouping and marker drawing, returning success status.
